IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Water, Energy & Environment.

Bill.BriefDescription: Encouraging the use of hydroelectric power as a renewable energy resource.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to encouraging the use of hydroelectric power as arenewable energy resource; adding a new section to chapter 43.21F RCW;and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) Water is a clean and sustainable resource that produces clean,efficient, and lowcost power; (2) There is an increasing demand for clean and renewable power; (3) Hydroelectric power is an abundant and reliable source of powerwith potential for growth; (4) Hydroelectric power makes a valuable contribution to thestate's electricity network and accounts for more than half of thestate's overall fuel mix; and (5) Hydroelectric power balances the needs of the environment withthe need for clean, nonpolluting, reliable, and abundant electricityfor the electrical market.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21F RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the policy of the state of Washington to recognizehydroelectric power as a renewable energy resource and to encourage itsuse.
